item.title: Gym Promo With Visit Details

turns.text: Make a 10-second vertical promo for Northside Gym. Use a welcoming gym scene, not hardcore bodybuilding, with upbeat music and no voiceover. Keep these details on screen together for the last 5 seconds: “Northside Gym”, “18 Cedar Road”, “Mon–Fri 6am–10pm”, “Sat–Sun 8am–6pm”. Big enough to read on a phone.

item.tests: Tests accurate, phone-readable address and opening-hours overlays held long enough to use in a short local-business ad.

answer_sheet.Business name and address: Northside Gym; 18 Cedar Road. Do not add a city, postcode or other contact details.
answer_sheet.Text timing: Show the name, address and both hours lines together throughout the last 5 seconds.
answer_sheet.Format and duration: Vertical 9:16, 10 seconds, readable on a phone.
answer_sheet.Visuals and style: A welcoming gym scene, not hardcore bodybuilding. Specific scene, colours and transitions are your call.
answer_sheet.Audio and language: Upbeat music, no voiceover. English text.

must_haves: The visuals depict a welcoming gym rather than an intimidating bodybuilding-focused environment.
The text reads exactly 'Northside Gym', '18 Cedar Road', 'Mon–Fri 6am–10pm' and 'Sat–Sun 8am–6pm'.
All four text lines are visible together continuously during the final 5 seconds.
The details are large, high-contrast and fully inside the frame, with no overlapping or clipped characters.
The finished promo is vertical, lasts approximately 10 seconds, and includes upbeat music without voiceover.

turns.agent:

The request preserved your specifications: 10 seconds, vertical, a welcoming gym scene, upbeat instrumental music, no voiceover, and all four details displayed together in large text for the final five seconds.

Add credits to proceed. Magic Hour also requires a paid plan or credit-pack purchase for commercial use.

approvals.name: create_video_from_text

style.prompt: Create a 10-second vertical 9:16 promo video for Northside Gym. Bright, welcoming neighborhood fitness studio, natural daylight, approachable everyday adult members of varied fitness levels, friendly relaxed smiles, comfortable workout clothing. Show light exercise, walking on a treadmill and a trainer welcoming a member. Not hardcore bodybuilding, no intimidating physique focus, no heavy lifting montage. Smooth slow camera movement, warm upbeat inviting atmosphere. AUDIO: upbeat cheerful instrumental pop music, steady energetic beat; absolutely no voiceover, dialogue, singing or speech. TIMELINE: first 0–5 seconds show the welcoming gym scene. From exactly 5 seconds through 10 seconds, show a stable large high-contrast dark navy information panel over the gym background. All FOUR of these text lines must appear TOGETHER continuously throughout the entire final five seconds, exactly spelled: “Northside Gym” / “18 Cedar Road” / “Mon–Fri 6am–10pm” / “Sat–Sun 8am–6pm”. Render the text as clean bold white sans serif, with Northside Gym as the largest heading, other three lines large and equal sized. Center the four lines as a single uncluttered block with generous line spacing, ample margins safe from phone UI overlays, big enough to read on a phone. All lines fully visible simultaneously, no scrolling, no staggered text animation, no extra text or invented offers. Hold the information panel steady until the very last frame, no fade-out obscuring information.
